MeasuredVariableDeletionSAT:
∀ (G D : Language Bool) (hG : G ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P) (hD : D ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P)
    (hsub : ∀ φ ψ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, ψ.Sublist φ → PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ ∈ G → PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ψ ∈ G)
    (hDspec : ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ ∈ G → (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ ∈ D ↔ PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ)) (k : ℕ),
    ∃ test : List Bool × List Bool → Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair Computability.encodeBool test ∧
      ∀ φ ψ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, ψ.Sublist φ → (test (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ,PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ψ) = true ↔
        (∃ xs : List ℕ, xs.length ≤ k ∧
          PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF (φ.map (fun c => c.filter (fun l => decide (l.1 ∉ xs)))) ∈ G) ∧ PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable ψ)
ExactVariableDeletionSAT:
∀ (G D : Language Bool) (hG : G ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P) (hD : D ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P)
    (hsub : ∀ φ ψ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, ψ.Sublist φ → PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ ∈ G → PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ψ ∈ G)
    (hDspec : ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ ∈ G → (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ ∈ D ↔ PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ)) (k : ℕ),
    {x : List Bool | ∃ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ = x ∧
      ∃ xs : List ℕ, xs.length ≤ k ∧ PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF (φ.map (fun c => c.filter (fun l => decide (l.1 ∉ xs)))) ∈ G} ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P ∧
    {x : List Bool | ∃ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ = x ∧
      (∃ xs : List ℕ, xs.length ≤ k ∧ PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF (φ.map (fun c => c.filter (fun l => decide (l.1 ∉ xs)))) ∈ G) ∧
      PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ} ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P
ExactHornVariableDeletionSAT:
∀ (k : ℕ),
    {x : List Bool | ∃ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ = x ∧
      ∃ xs : List ℕ, xs.length ≤ k ∧ ∀ c ∈ φ,
        (c.filter (fun l => l.2 && decide (l.1 ∉ xs))).length ≤ 1} ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P ∧
    {x : List Bool | ∃ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ = x ∧
      (∃ xs : List ℕ, xs.length ≤ k ∧ ∀ c ∈ φ,
        (c.filter (fun l => l.2 && decide (l.1 ∉ xs))).length ≤ 1) ∧
      PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ} ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P
HornVariableDeletionSATSearch:
∀ (k : ℕ),
    ∃ search : List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) search ∧
      ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, (∃ xs : List ℕ, xs.length ≤ k ∧ ∀ c ∈ φ,
        (c.filter (fun l => l.2 && decide (l.1 ∉ xs))).length ≤ 1) →
        PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ → ∃ vs : List ℕ,
          search (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) = vs.flatMap (fun i => (i.bits.flatMap fun b => [true,b]) ++ [false,true]) ∧
          (search (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ)).length ≤ (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ).length ∧
          PEqualNP.Search.CNF.eval (fun i => decide (i ∈ vs)) φ = true
ExactRenamableHornVariableDeletionSAT:
∀ (k : ℕ),

      ∃ xs : List ℕ, xs.length ≤ k ∧ ∃ flip : PEqualNP.Search.Assignment, ∀ c ∈ φ,
        (c.filter (fun l => xor l.2 (flip l.1) && decide (l.1 ∉ xs))).length ≤ 1} ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P ∧
    {x : List Bool | ∃ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ = x ∧
      (∃ xs : List ℕ, xs.length ≤ k ∧ ∃ flip : PEqualNP.Search.Assignment, ∀ c ∈ φ,
        (c.filter (fun l => xor l.2 (flip l.1) && decide (l.1 ∉ xs))).length ≤ 1) ∧
      PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ} ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P
